review.discoveryFalsePositiveReview: Pre-seal draft AI title rule incorrectly matched AI&T Technician, an assembly/integration/test acronym. The sealed rule explicitly excludes AI&T. Corporate generative-AI advertising, AI-driven business-area boilerplate, abstract AI adoption and physical AI factory construction were found during historical development review and removed/tightened before sealing.
review.freshFalsePositiveReview: Validation has zero FPs. Sensitivity retains rtx:01858818 DSO Engineer: original artificial intelligence literal matches corporate Digital Technology marketing at the end of a DevSecOps posting. No new rule fires. This is an inherited baseline FP, not relabeled or papered over.
review.freshValidation: 150 postings, 37 positive: recall 32.43 to 59.46, F1 48.98 to 74.58, precision remains 100%, AP 49.10 to 69.46. Second disjoint 150: 27 positive, recall 37.04 to 62.96, F1 52.63 to 75.56, precision 90.91 to 94.44, AP 45.00 to 68.19. Gains persist after >=0.80 5-word Jaccard near-duplicate exclusion.
review.jobFit: 27380 actual Jobs caller/scorer comparisons on 1369 current cached postings pass with AI neutral, five untouched-preference profiles, null/configured travel/work-location and enabled/disabled. Target-specific legitimate detection changes are the only permitted score changes.
review.limitations: AI-reference labels, not independent human ground truth. Historical available-cache sample with employer/role bias. Near duplicates audited explicitly. Residual baseline FPs and conservative missed ML/CV knowledge remain; no claim of perfect detection or population accuracy. No second tuning round needed because the sealed candidate passes both fresh tests. Remaining 48 unused rows were subsequently included only in the complete-corpus safety replay.
review.recommendation: ACCEPT FOR PRODUCTION after ordinary release validation. One sealed candidate materially improves both strictly fresh samples and both near-duplicate-filtered sensitivity subsets. No newly introduced false positive in discovery, historical global reference, validation or sensitivity. Frozen labels remain unchanged.
review.scope: Only 11 added target rules. Original three target rules retained. Every other rule retains exact semantic fields and relative order; executionOrder is mechanically renumbered by required canonical ordering. All 84 untouched concepts have exact presence/evidence/accepted-rule parity in every replay dataset.
